profile.headline: Embedded Audio Engineer
profile.summary: I am into anything with audio, software and hardware.

positions.title: Embedded Audio Software Engineer
positions.description:
-  Designed and built standalone engineering software that allowed acoustic team to analyze biquad filter designs with Python. Increased the development speed of DSP filter design by more than 10x.

- Led effort to synchronize the metadata transfer system from Mic Pod to host device. The older system needed to be updated to the latest version so that we could use one Mic Pod build for both the Rally System/Rally Bar and Rally Bar Mini. It required multiple changes to different repositories concurrently and close collaboration with other departments.

- Implemented a series of software updates to Rally system that brought the audio algorithms up to date with the latest advances.

- Improved the Mic Pod handoff performance by collaborating with acoustic/ML engineers and providing tangible improvements to the customer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: Works with a cross-functional team of firmware, electrical, software, and acoustic engineers to develop software for embedded audio systems, including smart speakers, soundbars and active subwoofers.

Subwoofers:
- Developed active subwoofer with latency of 1.5ms with signal processing being performed on a ARM Cortex-M STM32 part.  

- Implemented multi-task systems within a scheduler(FreeRTOS) that avoid blocking and adhere to tight timing requirements needed to process audio within a 0.66 ms frame time.

- Directed the integration of Mathworks/Simulink audio processing into a custom STM32 target board.  Orchestrated the collaboration between the acoustics team, software team and a third party consultant to achieve signal processing goals within schedule.

- Wrote C code to control UX functionality of subwoofer and collaborated with teammates remotely using git.

Soundbars:
- Utilizes clean and efficient coding practices in Java and refactors legacy code to improve readability and decouple module functionality.

- Utilize Android API to develop an app on an embedded Android OS.  The app communicates over I2C and UART to several ICs that control audio DSP, HDMI/CEC, IR commands, LED animations and many other functions.

positions.title: Associate Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
Role: Developed hardware for sound bars and smart speakers with Google Cast functionality

- Utilize Audio Precision to test I2S data bus signal integrity
- Tested complex 6 layer PCBAs with multiple BGAs and QFP ICs.
- Designed debug board PCB layout in Altium.
- Experience with standard data bus interfaces (I2C, SPI, I2S, UART, USB, S/PDIF)
- Tested RF RSSI(Received Signal Strength Indication) in RF test facility, and debugged WIFI antenna issues on a dual antenna array
- International travel experience, visited offices in Shenzhen, China to bring up first production run of DT Studio Advance and Slim PCBA’s


Products: Definitive Technology Studio Advance and Studio Slim Sound Bars

positions.title: Engineering Technician
positions.description:
Role: Provided technical support to engineers in the development and design of passive loudspeakers, soundbars and smart speakers.

Highlights:
- Automated a manual 16 hour DSP firmware compilation process into 10 seconds of processing using VBA in Excel.
- Created an automatic voice assistant test system would test the responsiveness of voice assistant system over varying levels of speech playback.

positions.title: Live Sound Engineer
positions.description: Soundboard engineer(400+ person shows) for artists such as John Easterlin/Freda Payne.  Role required leading small teams of assistants to set up and provide correct sound amplification for many genres

educations.fieldOfStudy: Audio Engineering with a focus in Computer Science
